basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Hamburg, Germany, who loves to explore new gadgets and gaming gear. While I have always been a fan of PlayStation, I'm now delving into the world of PC gaming. My interests include building custom PCs, historical shipwrecks, and occasionally indulging in German comedy. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work at a local electronics store. Single, and often found hanging out with a small circle of friends who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained technical expertise through hands-on experience and self-teaching. I learned about PC components and assembly from online forums and YouTube channels. My work at the electronics store also provides practical knowledge of the latest tech trends.
